Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or freelance projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies branding expertise at scale. About the Role 10x Team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are seeking knowledgeable branding professionals based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered brand and marketing systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to branding, brand messaging, content creation, and digital brand experiences - Evaluate AI responses for brand alignment, clarity, and compliance with real-world expectations - Draft realistic branding scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. brand specialist, client, marketing lead, or audience member) - Identify gaps, weaknesses, or inconsistencies in AI-generated branding content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects authentic brand reasoning, practical messaging, and real-world brand strategies. Rather than conducting traditional branding work, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about branding practices at scale. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9287a807-95ab-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX Designer – Retail & Operational Systems based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to shape intuitive, efficient digital experiences for frontline retail and financial operations. You will design transactional systems used in fast-paced, compliance-driven environments where usability, accuracy, and speed are critical. Your work will simplify complex workflows while helping users complete high-frequency tasks with fewer errors and less training. You’ll collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations, risk, compliance, and legal stakeholders to turn business and regulatory requirements into clear user experiences. The position combines research, workflow architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and design-system development. It is an ideal opportunity for a UX professional who enjoys solving complex operational problems and using emerging AI-assisted design tools to accelerate iteration. Observe frontline workflows to identify friction points, workarounds, training gaps, adoption barriers, and opportunities to improve operational efficiency. Lead UX design for high-frequency, compliance-sensitive retail and financial transactions, balancing user needs with business, regulatory, and technical constraints. Architect intuitive workflows covering areas such as item intake, pricing, customer profiles, loyalty enrollment, inventory, loan processing, payments, and fraud prevention. Design interfaces that prioritize data accuracy, keyboard-first and mobile navigation, conditional logic, validation, error prevention, and efficient task completion. Partner with product, engineering, operations, risk, compliance, and legal teams to translate business rules and regulatory requirements into usable interfaces and workflows. Create wireframes, interactive prototypes, annotated specifications, and pixel-perfect production-ready UI designs. Validate concepts through usability testing, workshops, design reviews, and iterative feedback cycles. Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary keystrokes, shorten learning curves, streamline workflows, and minimize operational errors. Contribute to and evolve design systems and component libraries optimized for high-volume operational environments. Apply AI-assisted design and prototyping tools to accelerate exploration and iteration while maintaining strong standards for usability and visual quality. Requirements 4+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, particularly with operational workflows, internal tools, transaction-processing platforms, or similarly complex systems. Strong expertise in information architecture, form design, workflow optimization, conditional logic, and task-oriented interaction design. Hands-on experience creating, maintaining, and evolving design systems and reusable component libraries. Advanced visual design skills with a strong eye for typography, color, spacing, hierarchy, consistency, and interaction details. Demonstrated ability to translate regulatory, compliance, and business requirements into clear and intuitive user experiences. Advanced proficiency with Figma , including Figma AI and Figma Make . Strong ability to communicate design rationale and collaborate effectively with engineering, product, operations, compliance, and leadership teams. Curiosity and adaptability toward emerging design technologies and AI-assisted workflows. Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish . Experience with item valuation, customer onboarding, identity verification, loyalty programs, payments, or similar transactional systems is an asset. Experience designing task-oriented interfaces for non-desk users in high-volume retail or operational environments is an asset. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a3772762-e485-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager - Product based in Ireland. This is an opportunity to lead a high-impact product engineering team within an early-stage, fully distributed software environment. You’ll guide a compact group of engineers responsible for turning customer needs into valuable, reliable product capabilities. The team works across cloud spend management, data pipelines, visualization, and intuitive product experiences. You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to ensure engineering priorities remain aligned with customer needs and business goals. The role combines people leadership, delivery ownership, technical judgment, and organizational development. Establish clear priorities, maintain alignment across the team, remove delivery blockers, and ensure consistent progress toward product goals. Partner closely with Product and Design to translate customer needs and business priorities into focused engineering initiatives. Guide the team in balancing delivery speed, technical quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability when making engineering tradeoffs. Enable engineers to take ownership of features from initial concepts and technical planning through implementation, testing, and launch. Establish and maintain practical standards for software design, testing, documentation, technical decisions, and engineering processes. Support recruiting, onboarding, mentoring, and development of new engineering talent as the organization grows. Strengthen collaboration across engineering, product, design, and leadership to ensure decisions are clear and execution remains coordinated. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and strong communication. Help the team deliver dependable and performant product capabilities across spend management, data, visualization, and application infrastructure. Requirements Proven experience managing and developing software engineering teams, ideally within a product-focused technology environment. Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams, develop engineers, and create an environment where people can do their best work. Strong product mindset with the ability to understand customer needs, business priorities, and technical considerations when setting engineering direction. Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to maintain clarity across multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. Strong judgment when balancing velocity, engineering quality, technical debt, and customer impact. Experience enabling engineers to own features and projects throughout the complete development lifecycle. Comfortable operating in an early-stage or rapidly evolving environment where processes and priorities continue to develop. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Design, and senior leadership. Experience with or familiarity with modern software development environments such as TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Terraform, GCP, dbt, and Dagster is beneficial but not mandatory. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e3859333-5c27-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Engineer (Data Architecture) based in the United States. The Senior Data Engineer will help design, build, and evolve the data infrastructure powering a proprietary technology platform. You will work at the intersection of data engineering, architecture, product development, and client solutions to create reliable and scalable data capabilities. A significant portion of the role will focus on shared data products and platform architecture, while also supporting individual client pipelines. You will identify recurring needs across implementations and transform them into reusable models, frameworks, and configuration-driven solutions. The role places strong emphasis on data quality, testing, observability, standardization, performance, and long-term maintainability. You will collaborate with technical and business stakeholders while contributing to architecture decisions and mentoring other engineers. This is an opportunity to influence how modern data solutions are designed and scaled in a fast-moving, multi-client environment. Design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines and shared data products using BigQuery, dbt, Python, and orchestration technologies. Identify recurring patterns across client implementations and transform them into reusable models, frameworks, ingestion patterns, utilities, and shared capabilities. Develop configuration-driven solutions that balance standardization and scalability with the flexibility required by individual clients. Integrate, normalize, and process data from APIs and third-party platforms across the MarTech and AdTech ecosystem. Manage production data pipelines across a diverse client portfolio, troubleshoot complex issues, and identify systemic improvements that reduce recurring problems. Contribute to technical designs, architecture discussions, code reviews, engineering standards, and best practices. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other Data Engineers while helping improve overall engineering effectiveness. Help evolve client-specific implementations into shared data products, frameworks, and vertical-focused capabilities, including Retail Media and B2B solutions. redesignhealth-redesign-health:ashbyhq:c.description: Managing Director, New Ventures Redesign Health + Cedars-Sinai Digital Innovation Platform ABOUT THE COMPANY: Redesign Health https://www.redesignhealth.com/ is a global venture and applied technology firm focused on building next-generation healthcare companies. We manage venture capital and venture buyout strategies, each powered by an AI operating system and team of leading technologists, entrepreneurs, and investors. Our venture capital strategy backs exceptional founders at the earliest stage—often before an idea is fully formed—and provides first institutional capital and an unmatched degree of strategic leverage and domain expertise through exit. Our venture buyout strategy partners with proven management teams through control investments and delivers outsized value by rewiring core products and workflows with AI. Since inception in 2018, Redesign and our portfolio companies have touched the lives of more than 15 million patients, raised over $1.5 billion from premier institutional, sovereign, and strategic investors, and built distinctive partnerships with marquee healthcare organizations and senior leaders around the world. Redesign is based in New York and has offices in Bengaluru, Los Angeles, and Riyadh. ABOUT THE ROLE: Most healthcare investors wait for companies to come to them. This role creates them. Redesign Health and Cedars-Sinai have launched a Digital Innovation Platform, a first-of-its-kind venture creation engine embedded inside one of the world’s premier academic medical centers. The platform combines Redesign’s healthcare company-building methodology with something no standalone venture firm can offer: Cedars-Sinai’s 4,500+ physicians and nurses, its expansive clinical network of 40+ hospitals and sites of care, a purpose-built synthetic and de-identified data platform, and a standing commitment to serve as the first customer for every company the platform creates. Ideas originate from the clinicians and researchers who see problems up close every day. The companies that emerge are validated in real clinical environments before they ever reach the broader market. This is an unparalleled opportunity to build generational healthcare companies. You will have something almost no one in healthcare venture has: a fully committed institutional partner with world-class clinical expertise, deep data assets, and the infrastructure to pilot and validate at scale - all before a company writes its first check to a customer. The access is real. The commitment is structural, not performative. As Managing Director, New Ventures, you will run Redesign’s side of this partnership end to end. This is a -1 to 0 role. Your job is to take clinical pain points and institutional white space and turn them into funded, founder-led operating companies. You will work inside Cedars-Sinai’s innovation infrastructure to surface high-conviction opportunities, develop original investment theses around them, attract exceptional founders, and shepherd concepts through co-ideation and diligence to Redesign’s Investment Committee. The right person for this role has built things before: companies, investment theses, teams, or programs in healthcare. You might come from venture capital, corporate venture, health system innovation, strategy, or operations. What matters more than your last title is that you have the commercial judgment to know which problems are worth solving, the taste to identify founding talent, and the credibility to be taken seriously by clinicians, executives, and entrepreneurs in the same week. You are the kind of person who earns trust inside institutions and moves with urgency once you have it. This position is based in Los Angeles. You get to be onsite 3–4 days per week in our Cedars-Sinai office. WHAT YOU’LL DO: PARTNERSHIP OPERATIONS & GOVERNANCE Own the day-to-day relationship between Redesign Health and Cedars-Sinai.
